title: Broad review of flashlight/orbit code
objective: Review the flashlight and orbit collection code across the current working tree and recent local fork commits, focusing first on correctness/regression risk and then on feature completeness, usability, and organization.
instructions: Review current uncommitted changes plus relevant scripts/features added in recent local commits, especially examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py, examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py, examples/flashlight/render_orbit_light_on_off.sh, examples/flashlight/light_settings.example.json, tests/test_orbit_collection_validation.py, examples/flashlight/README.md, and docs/running_our_example_applications.md.
Use read-only repository inspection as needed, including git status, git diff, and recent git log/show, to understand code added before this session in the user's fork.

Prioritize correctness findings: runtime failures, simulator/API misuse, unsafe file handling, stale output contracts, control mapping mistakes, depth/RGB data bugs, validation gaps, and behavior that contradicts docs or user workflow.
Secondarily review feature and organization quality: CLI ergonomics, naming, output layout, repeated code, test coverage, and whether the scripts are maintainable for active illumination experiments.

Run focused non-simulator validation where practical, such as py_compile, unit tests, shell syntax checks, JSON validation, rg searches for stale output names, and any lightweight smoke checks that do not require SPEAR running.
Do not modify product code unless a tiny review-only probe is impossible otherwise; prefer reporting findings with file/line references.
constraints: Do not commit, stage, reset, clean, or perform destructive Git operations.
Do not run simulator-dependent live render/teleop commands.
expected_outputs: ResultPacket with findings first, ordered by severity, with file/line references, validation run, residual risks, and recommendations.
definition_of_done: Correctness risks and feature/organization issues in the flashlight/orbit scripts and docs/tests have been reviewed and reported, or scope limitations are explicit.
